integrity: Mathematical proof specifies the complete Fano-subset projection; two standalone independently implemented checkers enumerate every one of 16,384 configurations and reproduce exact basins and the sharp two-step transient. Primary works and their unequal scope are identified; the standard period-at-most-two result is not presented as new.
scientific_limitations: The results concern synchronous strict open-neighbor majority on the labelled fourteen-vertex Fano incidence graph only. No extension to larger projective planes, noisy or asynchronous dynamics, or all cubic graphs is asserted. Independent historical priority and external replication remain unverified.
title: A two-step majority projection and exact attraction basins on the Heawood graph
